description: h(z) = prod_j (z - zeros[j]) / ( exp(log_c) * prod_k (z - poles[k])^pole_orders[k] ). The smoothed text is S = { z : |h(z)| < 1 } (one simply connected region; 'outline' traces its boundary |h| = 1). h is holomorphic on the region except at the poles inside it (h = infinity there); it maps S into |z| < 1 and every other point of the region into |z| > 1. 'disk_map' is the one-to-one conformal map phi of S onto |w| < 1: phi(z) = (z - z0) * exp( q0 + sum_k q[k] log(z - charges[k]) - i theta0 ), using the branch sum_k q[k] log(z - c_k) = sum_{k<K-1} s_k Log((z - c_k)/(z - c_{k+1})) with s_k = q[0]+..+q[k] (sum q = 0), so the branch cuts are the segments between consecutive charges.
